<function name="OnMouseWheeled" parent="PANEL" type="hook">
	<description>Called whenever the mouse wheel was used.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="scrollDelta" type="number">The scroll delta, indicating how much the user turned the mouse wheel.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to suppress default action.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
